orientations.intent: Determine whether any available tools can query a hosted error-telemetry index.

final_message:
Based on the tool exploration, none of the available handles (repo, tests, git, episodes) expose a verb for querying a hosted error-telemetry index. The tools available are limited to local repository status/inspection (repo), running a test suite (tests), git operations (git), and episode/session history (episodes) — none of which provide access to an external or hosted error-telemetry/monitoring service (e.g., Sentry, Datadog, etc.).

**Answer: No.** The available tools do not include any capability to query a hosted error-telemetry index — they are scoped to local repo status, test execution, git, and episode history only.
